name: review-packet
title: Content review packet
for_each: select id,code from documents order by code

sections.title: Evidence gaps
sections.sql: select rule,finding from v_compliance where id=$1

sections.title: Claim evidence
sections.sql: select c.statement,c.evidence,c.reviewer,c.valid_until from claims c join v_current d on d.revision_id=c.revision_id where d.id=$1

sections.title: Check history
sections.sql: select s.created_at,s.actor,s.findings from scans s join revisions r on r.id=s.revision_id where r.document_id=$1 order by s.created_at

sections.title: Approval history
sections.note: Historical decisions. Run release-check for current readiness.
sections.sql: select r.version,a.reviewer,a.note,a.created_at from approvals a join revisions r on r.id=a.revision_id where r.document_id=$1
